decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, management has little reason to search for other uses of its resources.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the filtration portfolio, and the large firm's slack lets it carry the product while early results remain uncertain.
The coolant nozzle line is a low-cost add-on that supports system sales and service revenue, so dropping it after one year would be premature.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits very close to the established offer and fits routines and customer demand, making it unlikely to fall short of aspirations.
The magnetic belt conveyor builds on core conveying competence for metalworking users, and nothing in the evidence suggests poor performance.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a staple of the core chip conveyor range and is expected to meet aspirations based on the firm's past performance.
